snippet.title: Fans from every generation debate modern football
snippet.description:
Welcome to Episode 2 of Generational, our series that brings together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game.

This time, we're diving into the evolution of modern football and asking some seriously controversial questions:

⚽️ Has the Premier League ruined football?
👴 Could players from the 60s and 70s actually cope in today's game?
🔥 Is Jack Grealish better than Pelé?
🏆 Is the FA Cup still a major trophy?
👀 Should Manchester City be stripped of their trophies if they're found guilty?
🤔 And plenty more heated debates between the generations along the way...

Who makes the best arguments? And which generation actually knows football best?

With different generations bringing different perspectives, experiences and opinions, expect plenty of disagreement, passionate arguments and some surprising takes.

Who do you agree with? Let us know your thoughts in the comments and tell us which debate caused the biggest divide.
